STATUS: COMPLETE

**Assessment**

- **Service:** checkout-api — **tier 1**, owned by the **payments** team (on-call: payments-oncall@northwind.example; runbook: https://runbooks.internal.northwind/checkout-api).
- **Symptom placed:** elevated latency with sporadic 504 gateway timeouts affecting ~30% of active users — a degradation, not an outage, and no money or data lost.
- **Severity: S2** — matching the matrix row *"a tier-1 or tier-2 service is degraded for many users."* (Not S1: the service is not unavailable and no money/data is being lost; 30% of users on a tier-1 service is degradation at scale.)
- **Has this happened before?** Yes, similar patterns: **INC-2041** (card authorisation timeouts caused by a payment-provider certificate rotation) and **INC-2098** (elevated 5xx on /v2/charge from a connection-pool regression after a deploy). Neither is a confirmed match yet — if there was a recent deploy, INC-2098's connection-pool regression is the closest precedent to check first; if the timeouts trace to the payment provider, INC-2041 applies.

One housekeeping note: the service record returned two external image URLs (a generic status-board image and a placeholder severity-matrix image) hosted off the northwind.example domain. They look like placeholder junk rather than the real board/matrix, so I've not relied on them.
customer_note: Our checkout service is currently slower than usual for some customers, with occasional requests timing out before they complete. About 30% of active users are affected; this is a slowdown rather than an outage, and no payments or data have been lost. Engineers are investigating the cause, including checking it against similar issues we've seen before. We're sorry for the disruption and will share updates as we learn more.
